verifications.note: 中新社（2016-12-12）: “12日14时，来自中亚和塔里木气区的天然气到达福建省福州市，西气东输三线东段工程建成通气” — the East Section is stated as completed and gas-connected (建成通气) on 2016-12-12; states 吉安至龙岩段 completed 2016-10-15. Supports Status via context (a completed, gas-flowing trunk that has been in continuous service since is 'operating' by inference, per url_verifier's status-inference rule) and Start=2016; the article explicitly gives the Ji'an–Fuzhou routing, supporting Location.

福州新闻网（2016-12-12）: “标志着'西气东输'三线东段工程正式建成通气，进入调试阶段” — independent local-outlet report of the same Dec 2016 gas-in event, confirms Status/Start by context, and gives the same Ji'an–Fuzhou routing (起于...吉安联络站，止于福建省福州末站).

resolutions.researcher_notes: Two independent 2016-12-12 outlets (China News Service, a national wire, and Fuzhou News, a local outlet) both report the East Section (Ji'an–Fuzhou) as 建成通气 (completed/gas-connected), the Longyan–Fuzhou sub-segment specifically that day and the Ji'an–Longyan sub-segment on 2016-10-15. Status='operating' is inferred by context per url_verifier convention (a completed, gas-flowing trunk in continuous service since 2016 is operating; the literal word does not appear, which is expected). No contrary/superseding status reporting found.

verifications.note: “来自中亚和塔里木气区的天然气到达福建省福州市” — states the fuel is natural gas (天然气) sourced from Central Asia and the Tarim basin, delivered along this East Section. Segment-level (the article is specifically about the Ji'an–Fuzhou completion).
“主供气源为新增进口中亚土库曼斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、哈萨克斯坦三国天然气，补充气源为新疆煤制天然气” — fuel is natural gas (imported Central Asian gas, supplemented by Xinjiang coal-to-gas). Independently confirms Fuel=Gas for this same segment.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Both outlets, reporting the same completion event, explicitly identify the transported fuel as natural gas (imported Central Asian gas plus Xinjiang coal-to-gas as a supplementary source). Confirms recorded Fuel='Gas'.
